parsed.name: DecaDAC多通道数模转换电压源
parsed.description: DecaDAC是一种多通道数模转换电压源，可输出可编程直流电压，并支持通道统一设定、斜坡扫描、触发和脚本序列控制。它常用于实验室中为器件提供偏置电压、进行参数扫描，以及执行需要多路稳定电压输出的自动化测量。
parsed.description_en: The DecaDAC is a multi-channel digital-to-analog voltage source that provides programmable DC outputs and supports global channel setting, voltage ramping, triggering, and scripted sequences. It is commonly used in laboratories to bias devices, perform parameter sweeps, and automate measurements requiring multiple stable voltage outputs.
